svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.21.3.7 Installation of Chimney Liners
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.21 MASONRY AND CONCRETE CHIMNEYS AND FLUES

g.text: Liner set as the surrounding masonry

svg.text: Chimney liners are installed when the
surrounding masonry or concrete is placed.
Drawn: chimney cut in half through the flue, liner tinted clay. Sizes are illustration only.
